text: Just finished the monthly call with Harbourline Logistics. Tomasz Wierzbicki, their operations director, confirmed they're going from two depots to three. The new Reno depot comes online on 15 July.
Their renewal is 31 July. Tomasz is our champion there, but Leon Marsh, their finance controller, signs off anything over $25k.
Tomasz also asked for the weekly KPI export as a CSV instead of the dashboard link. Can you note that?
Brackenridge Motors: Ada Mensah, their service director, wants to roll the booking module out to their four remaining dealerships in August. Draft a short rollout plan I can send her.
Shorter please, five lines max.
Calder Foods call this morning with two people: Sam Okoro, their finance manager, and Hannah Lindqvist, their IT lead.
Sam wants payment terms moved from net 30 to net 45 at renewal. Hannah needs SSO through Okta live by 19 June, before their audit.
They also want to run a demand forecasting pilot in July, but nobody on their side owns it yet.
Draft a follow-up to Hannah at Calder with the Okta SSO steps and the 19 June target.
Intro call with Pinecrest School District; they run 11 schools. My contacts are Sam Reyes, their IT director, and Gwen Hollis, head of procurement.
Sam wants a demo of the parent portal for his principals, and they'd need SSO through Google Workspace, not Microsoft.
Gwen can't issue a contract until she has our certificate of insurance.
Rowan & Pike: Felix Arden says the partners signed the contract last night. 25 seats, starting 1 July.
Draft a thank-you to Felix and propose an onboarding call in the week of 22 June.
Quick Harbourline one: Tomasz confirmed Reno is still on for 15 July, and Leon approved the $28k for the third depot's licences.
Asked our finance team about Calder's net 45 request. They'll accept it if Calder commits to a two-year term. How do I pitch that to Sam?

Big news from Harbourline: Tomasz is leaving. His last day is Friday 12 June. Rachel Adeyemi takes over as operations director from 15 June; she's coming from a retail logistics firm, so she's new to us.
Small world: Tomasz is joining Calder Foods as Head of Supply Chain from 22 June, and he's told them he wants to sponsor the forecasting pilot there.
So I'm losing my champion at Harbourline right before their renewal, but gaining one at Calder. What should I do on each account over the next two weeks?
Pinecrest: Sam Reyes confirmed the parent portal demo for Tuesday 23 June at 2pm, with five of their principals.
Gwen has our insurance certificate now, so the contract can move.
Brackenridge: Ada approved the August rollout plan. The first dealership is Kettering, on 3 August.
Calder: Hannah says Okta SSO is configured on their side, testing on Thursday.
Sam Okoro agreed to the two-year term in exchange for net 45. Draft a short confirmation to Sam.
Had a goodbye call with Tomasz. He's handing the KPI CSV and the Reno plan over to Rachel.
Draft a short farewell note to Tomasz from me, and say I'm looking forward to working with him at Calder.
Intro call with Rachel Adeyemi at Harbourline, her first day. She wants to revisit the depot rollout: Reno might slip to September because of a lease problem.
She'd also like a monthly in-person review instead of the monthly call. Leon is still the one approving spend.
Draft a welcome email to Rachel proposing the first in-person review in early July.
Calder's Okta SSO passed testing; Hannah says they're live in time for the audit.
Rowan & Pike onboarding call is booked for Wednesday 24 June at 11.
Tomasz started at Calder today. Quick call: he wants the forecasting pilot to kick off in the week of 6 July, starting with their two chilled-goods sites.
Hannah will sort out data access on the IT side. Draft me a one-paragraph pilot summary I can share internally.
Prep me for the Pinecrest demo at 2 today. Who's my lead on their side, and what do they need from us?

expect.should: Identifies Sam Reyes, Pinecrest's IT director, as the lead and notes the demo is of the parent portal for their principals, with SSO through Google Workspace; any other Pinecrest contact named is Gwen Hollis in procurement
expect.should_not: Names people or details from other accounts as Pinecrest's, such as Sam Okoro, Hannah Lindqvist, Okta SSO or net 45 terms

text: Pinecrest demo went well. Sam wants pricing for all 11 schools by next Friday.
Harbourline renewal call is tomorrow. Who's on their side now, and what do they care about?

expect.should: Names Rachel Adeyemi as the new operations director and Leon Marsh as the finance controller who approves spend; Tomasz Wierzbicki is mentioned, if at all, only as having left (he moved to Calder Foods)
expect.should_not: Presents Tomasz Wierzbicki as a current Harbourline contact or expected attendee

text: I'm sending the invite for the Calder forecasting pilot kickoff. Who should be on it from their side?

expect.should: Includes Tomasz Wierzbicki as Calder's Head of Supply Chain and the pilot sponsor; including Hannah Lindqvist for data access or Sam Okoro is fine
expect.should_not: Leaves Tomasz out, describes him as working at Harbourline, or lists Harbourline people such as Rachel Adeyemi or Leon Marsh
